2197.label: alexis_event_08b
2197.source: She was reluctant at first, but once she agreed to report what Coach Blank had done to her, that set the wheels in motion.

2199.label: alexis_event_08b

2222.label: alexis_event_08b

2223.label: alexis_event_08b

2224.label: alexis_event_08b

2259.label: alexis_event_09a

2260.label: alexis_event_09a

2264.label: alexis_event_09a

2266.label: alexis_event_09a
2266.source: It wasn't my right to do that in your name.

2274.label: alexis_event_09a
2274.source: To pay for making me hate you, Alexis.

2275.label: alexis_event_09a

2326.label: alexis_event_10
2326.source: But then I start to think about what she's saying.

2332.label: alexis_event_10

2358.label: alexis_event_10
